![](/images/collaborations/Physalia-Logo-1000x358.png){width="35%" fig-alt="Physalia Courses logo"}

Bioconductor partners with [Physalia Courses](https://www.physalia-courses.org/) to support training in bioinformatics and computational biology using Bioconductor.

Courses listed here fall into two categories:

- **Bioconductor-Physalia**: co-branded courses led by instructors with established teaching experience within the Bioconductor/Carpentries training community.
- **Bioconductor-associated**: Physalia courses with substantial Bioconductor content that are supported through the collaboration. This provides a route for additional instructors and courses to engage with the Bioconductor training community.

All courses listed below offer two free places for participants from low- and middle-income countries.

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)

workshops <- read_tsv("../../data/workshops.tsv")

# ---- Date parsing helpers ----

parse_start_date <- function(date_str) {

  # Put vague/TBD dates at the end of the upcoming list
  if (grepl("TBD|Early|Late", date_str, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(as.Date("2099-12-31"))
  }

  # Date ranges, e.g. "9-18 November 2026"
  if (grepl(
    "^\\d{1,2}\\s*[-–]\\s*\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$",
    date_str
  )) {
    start_day <- str_extract(date_str, "^\\d{1,2}")
    month_year <- str_extract(
      date_str,
      "[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$"
    )

    return(
      dmy(
        paste(start_day, month_year),
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    )
  }

  # Multiple dates, e.g. "16, 17, 18 & 20 November 2026"
  if (grepl("[,&]", date_str)) {
    start_day <- str_extract(date_str, "^\\d{1,2}")
    month_year <- str_extract(
      date_str,
      "[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$"
    )

    return(
      dmy(
        paste(start_day, month_year),
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    )
  }

  # Year only, e.g. "2027"
  if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", date_str)) {
    return(
      ymd(
        paste0(date_str, "-01-01"),
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    )
  }

  # Single date, e.g. "27 January 2027"
  parsed_date <- dmy(
    date_str,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  # Month/year, e.g. "January 2027"
  if (is.na(parsed_date)) {
    parsed_date <- my(
      date_str,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  }

  # Fall back to end of list if parsing fails
  if (is.na(parsed_date)) {
    parsed_date <- as.Date("2099-12-31")
  }

  parsed_date
}


parse_end_date <- function(date_str) {

  # Treat vague/TBD dates as upcoming
  if (grepl("TBD|Early|Late", date_str, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(as.Date("2099-12-31"))
  }

  # Extract final explicit date where possible.
  # Handles:
  # "9-18 November 2026"
  # "16, 17, 18 & 20 November 2026"
  end_date_str <- str_extract(
    date_str,
    "\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$"
  )

  parsed_date <- dmy(
    end_date_str,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  # Single date
  if (is.na(parsed_date)) {
    parsed_date <- dmy(
      date_str,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  }

  # Month/year
  if (is.na(parsed_date)) {
    parsed_date <- my(
      date_str,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  }

  # Year only
  if (
    is.na(parsed_date) &&
      grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", date_str)
  ) {
    parsed_date <- ymd(
      paste0(date_str, "-12-31"),
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  }

  # Fall back to upcoming if parsing fails
  if (is.na(parsed_date)) {
    parsed_date <- as.Date("2099-12-31")
  }

  parsed_date
}


determine_status <- function(date_str) {

  end_date <- parse_end_date(date_str)

  if (end_date >= today()) {
    "upcoming"
  } else {
    "past"
  }
}

# ---- Physalia courses ----

physalia_raw <- workshops %>%
  mutate(tsv_row = row_number() + 1) %>%
  filter(initiative == "Physalia")

# Require an explicit collaboration type for every Physalia course
allowed_types <- c(
  "bioconductor-physalia",
  "bioconductor-associated"
)

invalid_physalia <- physalia_raw %>%
  filter(
    is.na(collaboration_type) |
      collaboration_type == "" |
      !collaboration_type %in% allowed_types
  )

if (nrow(invalid_physalia) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Invalid or missing collaboration_type in Physalia row(s):\n",
      paste(
        sprintf(
          "Row %s: %s",
          invalid_physalia$tsv_row,
          invalid_physalia$title
        ),
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    )
  )
}

physalia <- physalia_raw %>%
  mutate(
    status = map_chr(
      date,
      determine_status
    ),

    # Sort courses by START date
    sort_date = as.Date(
      map_chr(
        date,
        ~ as.character(parse_start_date(.x))
      )
    ),

    type_label = recode(
      collaboration_type,
      "bioconductor-physalia" = "Bioconductor-Physalia",
      "bioconductor-associated" = "Bioconductor-associated"
    ),

    title_html = sprintf(
      '%s<br><span class="course-type">%s</span>',
      htmlEscape(title),
      htmlEscape(type_label)
    ),

    link_html = case_when(
      !is.na(workshop_url) & workshop_url != "" ~
        sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank">View Course</a>',
          workshop_url
        ),

      !is.na(previous_edition_url) & previous_edition_url != "" ~
        sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank">View Previous Edition</a>',
          previous_edition_url
        ),

      TRUE ~ "New Course"
    )
  )

# ---- Upcoming / Past ----

upcoming <- physalia %>%
  filter(status == "upcoming") %>%
  arrange(sort_date) %>%
  select(
    date,
    title_html,
    instructors,
    link_html
  )

past <- physalia %>%
  filter(status == "past") %>%
  arrange(desc(sort_date)) %>%
  select(
    date,
    title_html,
    instructors,
    link_html
  )

# ---- Tables ----

upcoming_table <- reactable(
  upcoming,
  compact = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    title_html = colDef(
      name = "Title",
      html = TRUE
    ),
    link_html = colDef(
      name = "Workshop Link",
      html = TRUE
    )
  )
)

past_table <- reactable(
  past,
  compact = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    title_html = colDef(
      name = "Title",
      html = TRUE
    ),
    link_html = colDef(
      name = "Workshop Link",
      html = TRUE
    )
  )
)

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::h2("Upcoming"),
  upcoming_table,
  htmltools::h2("Past"),
  past_table
)
```

## Free Seats for Participants from Low- and Middle-Income Countries

Two free seats are available for each course listed above for participants based in low- or middle-income countries, as defined by the [World Bank's income classification](https://datatopics.worldbank.org/world-development-indicators/the-world-by-income-and-region.html).

[Apply here to be considered](https://forms.gle/w4UEBu3VrJXemtTN9)

## Learn More

Read the [blog post](https://blog.bioconductor.org/posts/2025-06-20-physalia-collaboration/) announcing the collaboration to learn more about how it came together and what it aims to achieve.
